verdict.rationale: Elicit's first-party docs say you can invite team members to collaborate live in Research Agent sessions, and collaborators with edit access can ask the agent questions, create new artifacts, and edit existing ones. That covers both viewing and building on a shared session. Reports can also be exported as PDF or Word for wider distribution. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of view-only permission levels or share links, documented sharing of Systematic Review reports and Projects, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the collaboration feature.
